def logsumexp(a, b=1.0):
    """Stable log-sum-exp for array a with temperature b."""
    a = np.asarray(a, dtype=np.float64)
    amax = np.max(a)
    if not np.isfinite(amax):
        return amax
    return amax + math.log(np.sum(np.exp((a - amax) / b))) * b
